question: Where were the first modern Olympic Games held under the IOC?
solution:
The correct answer is __**In Athens.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **International Olympic Committee (IOC):**

 
 
• One **non-governmental organization **involved in sports is the International Olympic Committee.
 
• It is s**ituated in Switzerland's Lausanne.**
 
• **Pierre de Coubertin founded the IOC on June 23, 1894.**
 
• Demetrios Vikelas served as its first president. 
 
• The International Olympic Committee (IOC) oversees both the national Olympic Committees (NOCs) and the global Olympic Movement.
 
• **Thomas Bach is its president at the moment.**
 
• Every four years, the IOC plans the Youth Olympic Games (YOG) and the contemporary Olympic Games, which are held in the summer and winter.
